actions.title: Clear the 8 municipalities inside the new-water footprint first: Sueca, València, Sollana and 5 more.
actions.sat: New water jumped from 30.7 to 77.7 km² between 26 and 31 Oct, mapped through cloud. These 8 hold 75.8 km² of it.
actions.out: Rescue and evacuation start from a radar map on day two instead of from phone calls.
actions.src: NASA/JPL OPERA DSWx-S1, 30 m; municipality outlines from OpenStreetMap.

tasks.label: Rescue teams to Sueca and València
Pull the next Sentinel-1 / OPERA pass

alert.to: Civil-protection teams and residents of the 8 municipalities
alert.head: Flood water mapped in 8 municipalities: Sueca, València, Sollana and 5 more
lines: Radar on 31 Oct shows 77.7 km² of new water outside normal water bodies, up from 30.7 km² on 26 Oct. These 8 towns hold 75.8 km² of it.
Rain upstream on 29 Oct: 91 mm on average, 135 mm in the wettest 10 km cell.
Stay off low ground and flooded roads, and follow civil-protection instructions.
alert.src: NASA/JPL OPERA DSWx-S1 (Sentinel-1 radar, 30 m); NASA GPM IMERG V07 daily rain.

actions.title: Send damage teams to the 7 municipalities still wet three weeks later, and drone-survey the streets of 8 l'Horta Sud towns where radar sees almost no water.
actions.sat: 52.0 km² was still new water on 19 Nov. In Paiporta, Picanya, Sedaví and nearby towns, radar maps only 0.48 km²: water between buildings is a known radar blind spot.
actions.out: Teams go where water lingers, and the radar's blind spot is covered by drones and on foot.
actions.src: OPERA DSWx-S1 pass of 19 Nov 2024; urban under-detection is a documented limit of radar water maps.

tasks.label: Damage teams to Sueca and València
Drone street survey: Paiporta, Picanya, Sedaví

actions.title: Put retention basins and drainage upgrades for València, Alfafar, Silla, Catarroja and 3 more into next year's plan, sized for the 2024 event.
actions.sat: Water spread into these towns on the Albufera's edge: +17.8 km² of newly wet ground. The year's wettest day shows no 45-year trend (p = 0.28), so size for the event, not for a trend.
actions.out: The plan is built on what happened, and on what 45 years of rain data do and don't show.
actions.src: OPERA DSWx-S1 change 26 → 31 Oct 2024; NASA POWER 1981–2025 wettest day, Mann-Kendall p = 0.28 (GPM IMERG 1998–2024 agrees, p = 0.62).

tasks.label: Line in next year's municipal plan
Re-check with each new OPERA flood map

actions.title: Send farm recovery aid and crop-insurance checks to rice growers in Sueca, València, Sollana and Cullera.
actions.sat: Most new water sits in the Albufera rice paddies: 58.2 km² in these 4 municipalities, 28.6 km² in Sueca alone.
actions.out: Aid reaches the farms the flood covered, with urban losses flagged as larger than radar shows.
actions.src: OPERA DSWx-S1, 31 Oct 2024. The paddies were already filling before the storm (4 → 31 km², 1–26 Oct).
